names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 16 decembrie, «Sfântul Proroc Agheu», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Δεκεμβρίου, «Προφήτης Αγγαίος», with the rank word left off. The page glosses the name itself, «(εβραϊκή λέξη) = ευφροσύνη Κυρίου, εορτή».

floruit.note: doxologia.ro's life: «a prorocit cu Sfântul Proroc Zaharia, treizeci și șase de ani, mai înainte de întruparea Domnului Hristos cu patru sute șaptezeci de ani» — thirty-six years of prophesying, beginning four hundred and seventy years before the Incarnation; the later bound is that figure less those thirty-six years, and no other year is on the page.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (28 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 16 decembrie — «Sfântul Proroc Agheu»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Προφήτης Αγγαίος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same prophet: of the priestly tribe of Levi, born at Babylon during the captivity, buried in the graves of the priests. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr adds what the Romanian notice did not have — that he is the tenth of the so-called minor prophets, that his prophetic book is divided into two chapters and is plain and severe in style, and that he and the prophet Zacharias together rekindled the zeal of the Jews for the rebuilding of the temple of Solomon; and it quotes and glosses Haggai 2:14 against priests defiled by bribes taken early in the morning. **It gives no year at all**, so the folder's `dates`, which come from doxologia's «cu patru sute șaptezeci de ani» before the incarnation, are left exactly as they are. The Zacharias the page names is not identified further by it and the corpus holds many of that name, so no `related` row is made. It names Babylon and Jerusalem and no coordinate is proposed. It prints two apolytikia, both naming him, which are taken, and a kathisma, which is a kind the schema does not hold.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (28 September 2026).

hymns.text: A prorocului Tău, Doamne, Agheu pomenire prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.

english.text: As we keep the memory of your prophet Haggai, O Lord, we pray to you through him: save our souls.

hymns.text: Προφήτης θεόληπτος, οἴα θεράπων Θεοῦ, τῷ κόσμῳ ἐνδέδειξαι, ἀνακαθάρας τὸν νοῦν, Ἀγγαῖε πανεύφημε, ὅθεν ἑορταζόντων, ἔνθα πέφυκεν ἦχος, ἤρθης ὡς ἑορτάζων, ἐν Θεῷ φερωνύμως, ὦ πρέσβευε θεηγόρε, σώζεσθαι ἅπαντας.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first of the two the page prints, on the page of Προφήτης Αγγαίος. It names him or her.

english.text: A God-possessed prophet, like a servant of God, you were shown to the world, having cleansed your mind, O all-praised Haggai; and so you were taken up, where the sound of those who keep festival is, as one keeping festival in God according to your name. Intercede, O speaker of God, that all may be saved.

hymns.text: Τοῦ Προφήτου σου Ἀγγαίου τὴν μνὴμην, Κύριε ἑορτάζοντες, δι᾽ αὐτοῦ σε δυσωποῦμεν· Σῶσον τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος β’, printed without a model. It is the common of a prophet, printed under his name and naming him, so it is his service and is copied whole, on the page of Προφήτης Αγγαίος. It names him or her.

english.text: Keeping the memory of your prophet Haggai, O Lord, through him we implore you: save our souls.
